audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Skill on all seven rows; content win[3..6] and the packet chart both give Levels 4-5 onward to Annie.
audit.why: Ring of Frost is 450 range — Lissandra has to come inside Annie's 625 stun to land her own root — and Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1, so a spent claw leaves her with no exit. That is why the lane tips to Annie from level 4 and stays there, consistent with 51.79% over 1176 games.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side = Annie with ratings 6/7/7/6; rows 0-2 stay Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 row claimed Tibbers deletes her, with no mention that Frozen Tomb is a 120-second answer at rank 1 that goes untargetable and invulnerable.
audit.why: Riot's R text: self-cast encases her, healing while untargetable and invulnerable. The spike is real but the sequencing matters — stun first, let the bear finish after the Tomb expires. Her 120s cooldown is also the honest measure of when Annie can commit.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and breakdown.carry now carry the 120s number and the correct order of operations.

audit.whatIsWrong: The untargetable window was never stated anywhere, the 450-versus-625 range relationship was never stated, and the page called Lissandra "he" or "his" in seven fields.
audit.why: Dumping a full stun-Q-W-Tibbers into a self-cast Frozen Tomb is the losing play in this lane and nothing on the page warned against it — the damage is not reduced, it is voided, and she heals through it. Conversely, her only hard CC needs 450 range, which is strictly inside Annie's kill radius; that is the matchup in one number.
audit.corrected: Added to tldr, enemyWin, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags zero sequencing advice; breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers.
audit.why: Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 and 18s at rank 3 — one of the longest escape cooldowns a mid laner carries early — and Ice Shard drops from 7s to 3s, which is why her poke gets free later rather than earlier.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now appear in breakdown.cooldowns, phases[0].why, phases[3].why and dontsFull[0].d.
sources: enemyKit Q and E cooldown fields

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal despite the self-Tomb healing her.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal and Riot's R text confirms the heal. In a lane you win by repeated commits, Grievous Wounds is the difference between chunking her and chunking her twice.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now buys Oblivion Orb when she keeps surviving.
